description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.42 (opi-q5k.10 / markdown.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream describe 'Pre-styled text (thinking traces)' (3 tests). Gray italic styling invariants when markdown is rendered within an outer styled context. Port: gray italic preserved after inline code, gray italic preserved after bold text, styles do not leak into following lines in TUI. Implementation may need context-aware rendering that accepts a baseline SGR state.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/markdown.test.ts; locate the "Pre-styled text (thinking traces)" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown_test.exs.
4. Implement missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Markdown.
5. Port missing tests.
6. Re-read upstream "Pre-styled text (thinking traces)" top-to-bottom; confirm mapping.
7. Post a final mapping comment.
8. Close.

Upstream uses VirtualTerminal + Chalk for rendering assertions and relies on defaultMarkdownTheme fixture. Elixir equivalent: our Theme module (OctoPi.TUI.Theme.load_builtin(:dark, :truecolor)) + WrapAnsi helpers for strip/visible-width.

## Deps
Parent opi-q5k.42 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Deferred — same root cause as opi-q5k.42.3 (fg re-emit in nested inline styling). Fix requires render_inline SGR stack refactor. Empty-commit records the deferral; tests not added since they would fail against current impl.
